description: Find cases from Horizontal's Agent Cases: real, named people and companies making money with AI agents. Each result gives the revenue, who reported it and how strong that evidence is, the agents used, how it earns, and whether a team of one to three could copy it. Revenue is recorded as the sources state it; unless its evidence is verified, Horizontal has not checked it. Newest first, or the closest matches first when there are words.

agent.description: Only cases that used this agent or tool: "Claude Code", "Cursor", "OpenClaw".

evidence.description: Only cases with this level of evidence: verified (A third party checked the revenue: a read-only Stripe link on TrustMRR or AgentMRR, or a sale price reported by reliable press.); screenshot (The maker showed a dashboard: Stripe, App Store Connect or the like. Screenshots can be faked, but they are more than a bare claim.); self-reported (A number the maker gave in a post, video or interview, with no proof shown.); estimate (A data firm or analyst estimated it: Sensor Tower, AppMagic and the like.)

language.description: The language of the words in the answer.

query.description: What the case should be about, in English or Chinese: "Claude Code", "mobile game", "agency", "独立开发". Leave it out for the newest cases.

type.description: Only cases of this kind: agent-run (Run by agents), agent-built (Built with agents), agent-services (Selling agent work).

name: search_cases
title: Search real cases of making money with AI agents
